title: RexxOS-isolated service topology
summary: Narrow native modules and RexxOS isolation establish independently owned capability/service boundaries. The public site, NOC, Office, mail/gateway and MCP services are not one shared listener or authority.
invariants: Public rasenfalcon.com never dispatches Office or NOC private capabilities.
NOC and Office each run separate non-root native ooRexx HTTPS servers with distinct identities, process, TLS context, certificates, service unit and failure domain.
gateway.rasenfalcon.com owns native SMTP/IMAP plus Wire operations access.
office.rasenfalcon.com uses /mail and /notes; MCP uses a separately controlled endpoint.
Do not invent unknown host IPs, ports, keys or certificates.

provenance.claim: Logical host ownership and known DNS records.
